question: Through what union should one meditate on the light-principle nature?
premises: Meditation is directed to what is made of the light-principle
The means is the union of Kula and Akula
inference: One should meditate on the light-principle through the union of Kula and Akula
plain_english: One should meditate on that which is made of the light-principle, through the union of Kula and Akula.
